title: Counter State with ref
short_description: Practice creating, displaying, and updating reactive primitive state with ref.
description: In this challenge, you will complete a small counter component by creating its state with Vue's ref function.
The goal is to distinguish how a ref is handled inside <script setup> and how it is used from the template.
instructions: Import ref from vue and create state named 'count' with an initial value of 0.
Complete increment to increase the counter by 1 and reset to return it to its initial value.
Render the current counter value in the template.

hints.title: Create the state
hints.body: Import `ref` from `vue` and declare the state with `const count = ref(0)`

hints.title: Update a ref
hints.body: Inside the functions, update `count.value`: increase it in `increment` and assign `0` in `reset`

hints.title: Display the state
hints.body: In the template, you can write `{{ count }}`. Vue automatically displays the inner value of the ref.
